stages.log: The surveyor who logged your tow honestly was let go for it. Con-Reg put her out at the lanes in a lifepod. The surveyor's lifepod: marked on the chart, from the next sector on. She would sign on, given a berth.

objectives.text: Sign Ama on, or Drop her at the lanes
objectives.done-when: events.chose(event: lifepod, choice: signon) or events.chose(event: lifepod, choice: drop)

stages.fail-when: events.chose(event: lifepod, choice: report) or run.past-charts
stages.why: It went cold: hand her to recovery.
